subject: Physics
title: Magnetism and Matter
summary: Bar magnet bilkul current-carrying solenoid jaisa behave karta hai: dono magnetic dipoles hain jinka magnetic moment m S se N ki taraf hota hai.
Magnetic dipole ka field 1/r³ se girta hai: axis par same doori par equatorial line se double, aur dono fields ulti direction mein.
Uniform field mein dipole par torque τ = m × B (net force nahi) aur potential energy U = −m·B; compass needle ki tarah field direction ke around oscillate karta hai.

Materials diamagnetic (halka repel), paramagnetic (halka attract) ya ferromagnetic (zor se attract) hote hain. Paramagnetism temperature se kamzor hota hai (Curie's law); Curie temperature ke upar ferromagnet paramagnetic ban jaata hai.

formulas.name: Magnetic moment
formulas.formula: bar magnet: m = q_m × 2l;  current loop/solenoid: m = N I A
formulas.mistake: Direction: magnet ke andar S → N; loop ke liye right-hand rule — ulta mat lo.

formulas.name: Field on the axis of a dipole
formulas.when: Magnet ke axis par field (r ≫ length).

formulas.name: Field on the equatorial line
formulas.mistake: Same r par B_axial = 2 × B_equatorial — factor 2 ulta mat karo.

formulas.name: Torque on a dipole
formulas.formula: τ = m × B;  |τ| = mB sin θ
formulas.mistake: Uniform field mein net force zero — sirf torque lagta hai, force mat lo.

formulas.name: Oscillation of a magnet
formulas.when: Uniform field mein magnet ya compass needle ke chhote oscillations.

formulas.name: Magnetisation and intensity
formulas.formula: M = m_net/V;  H = B₀/μ₀;  B = μ₀(H + M)

formulas.name: Susceptibility and permeability
formulas.formula: χ = M/H;  μ = μ₀(1 + χ);  μᵣ = 1 + χ
formulas.mistake: Diamagnets: χ chhota aur negative; paramagnets: chhota positive; ferromagnets: bahut bada positive — mix mat karo.

formulas.name: Curie's law
formulas.mistake: Sirf paramagnets par lagta hai; diamagnetism temperature par lagbhag depend nahi karta.

formulas.name: Curie–Weiss law
formulas.formula: χ = C/(T − T_C) for T > T_C

topics.title: Bar magnet as an equivalent solenoid
topics.explain: Bar magnet aur solenoid ki field lines bahar se bilkul ek jaisi dikhti hain. Magnet ko aadha kaato to do chhote magnets bante hain — isolated magnetic poles (monopoles) exist nahi karte, electric charges ki tarah nahi.

topics.title: Magnetic field lines
topics.explain: Closed loops banati hain (bahar N → S, andar S → N), kabhi nahi kaat-ti, aur strong field mein ghani hoti hain. Gauss's law for magnetism: kisi bhi closed surface se net flux zero.

topics.title: Dipole in a uniform field
topics.explain: m B ke saath ho to stable equilibrium (minimum energy), ulta ho to unstable. Torque m ko B ke saath align karne ki koshish karta hai — compass isi se kaam karta hai.

topics.title: Diamagnetic substances
topics.explain: Halka repel hote hain, strong se weak field ki taraf jaate hain; χ chhota negative (≈ −10⁻⁵). Examples: bismuth, copper, lead, paani, nitrogen gas. Superconductors perfect diamagnets hain (Meissner effect).

topics.title: Paramagnetic substances
topics.explain: Halka attract hote hain, weak se strong field ki taraf; atoms ke permanent moments thode align hote hain. Examples: aluminium, sodium, calcium, oxygen gas, copper chloride. Temperature badhne par χ ghatta hai.

topics.title: Ferromagnetic substances
topics.explain: Zor se attract; domains aasaani se align hote hain. Examples: iron, cobalt, nickel, gadolinium. Curie temperature (Fe ≈ 1043 K) ke upar paramagnetic ban jaate hain. Soft iron (aasaani se magnetise/demagnetise) electromagnets aur transformer cores mein; steel permanent magnets ke liye.

topics.title: Syllabus note
topics.explain: Earth's magnetism (dip, declination, horizontal component) current NTA syllabus se hata diya gaya hai. Dipole fields, torque aur energy, aur teen tarah ke materials aur temperature ka effect padho.

ratta: τ = mB sinθ;  U = −mB cosθ;  W = mB(cosθ₁ − cosθ₂).
Dia: χ < 0;  para: small χ > 0;  ferro: huge χ.
Curie: χ = C/T (para);  ferro → para above T_C.
No magnetic monopoles; net flux through closed surface = 0.
